units.normalized_content: Observation-mapping change is not uniquely localized by the stated hierarchy: README Level 1 includes corrupted sensory mapping/observation-model adjustment, while THEORY Level 3 lists changed observation mapping as a mechanism failure. The source does not provide a discriminator separating these cases.
units.notes: Preserve both classifications; do not force one failure depth.

units.normalized_content: README uses target factorization L = L_hat ∘ O as the Level-5 interface criterion, while THEORY/CFAE use action-conditioned hypothesis discrimination via I(H;O|a) and max_a I(H;O|a). These are related but non-identical objects; the source does not establish equivalence or the conditions connecting them.
units.notes: No normalization between target identifiability and hypothesis distinguishability.

units.normalized_content: THEORY states that the agent accesses world state through an observation interface O_t=I(W_t), while CFAE defines transition residual e_T using s_{t+1} directly. The source does not specify whether s_{t+1} is internally observable, inferred, evaluator-only, or latent, leaving the operational observability requirement unresolved.
units.notes: Do not treat transition residual as implementable from observations without an explicit state-access contract.

units.normalized_content: C_improve divides by ΔI_necessary + λΔI_unnecessary, while correct abstention in noise/non-identifiable cases may require zero structural revision. The source does not specify the metric convention when the denominator is zero, including interface-wall cases where abstention is explicitly rewarded.
units.notes: Preserve undefined boundary; do not invent epsilon smoothing or alternate scoring.
